candidates.name: White Cable-Knit Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The white cable turtleneck is presented only as a shaped product cutout with a narrow waist and sleeve line, so it gives no credible on-body drape proof and risks the fitted-knit silhouette the brief excludes.

candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The peacock mock neck is visibly body-hugging through the chest, waist and arms with artificial product-only shaping; its color cannot compensate for the skinny silhouette.

candidates.name: Beige Fine-Knit Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The beige turtleneck is an isolated slim product render with no body proof, minimal texture and a washed neutral tone; it is too generic and uncertain for a polished evening look.

candidates.name: Brown Long-Sleeve Knit Polo
candidates.decisionReason: The brown knit polo has useful regular-relaxed ease, but the bright oversized buttons, long bunched sleeves and flat dark checker texture read casual and inexpensive rather than sharp Winter Formal.

candidates.name: Light-Khaki Textured Henley Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The light-khaki Henley has modern rib texture, but its dropped shoulders, elongated sleeves and product-only presentation leave the fit unproven while the crew-Henley construction remains too casual for Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Fine-Knit Crew
candidates.decisionReason: The blue fine-knit crew is visibly fitted across the chest, waist and arms and is styled with pushed three-quarter sleeves; it repeats the skinny-top problem instead of providing modern controlled ease.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated light-gray trouser has sporty articulated-knee seams and provides no seat, full-length or worn-drape proof, so it cannot support a formal tailoring approval.

candidates.name: Army-Green Pleated Corduroy Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The army-green corduroy trouser has a balloon taper, rolled cuffs, D-ring hardware and strong casual workwear texture; it conflicts directly with the clean straight Formal silhouette.

candidates.name: Military-Green Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The military-green trouser is shown unworn and wrinkled with novelty bead hardware and casual cotton construction; neither its drape nor its Formal quality is proven.

candidates.name: Dark Zip-Detail Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The dark washed jean has hip zip details, a low rise and a long puddled hem over chunky sneakers; it is visually heavy and street-casual rather than Formal Evening.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Straight Washed Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The gray washed jean has a broad loose leg with strong pooling and turn-up at the shoe plus a casual faded finish; it recreates the baggy-bottom problem and is not formal.
